# Get-AvmVersion

## Synopsis

Reports the running Avm.Authoring module version and host runtime.

## Description

Emits a single pscustomobject covering the module identity, the running
PowerShell version and edition, the detected OS, and the process
architecture. Warns when a newer module version is available without
preventing version reporting.

## CLI commands

- `avm version`

## Syntax

```powershell
Get-AvmVersion [-SkipModuleVersionCheck] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## Parameters

### -SkipModuleVersionCheck

Skip the PowerShell Gallery lookup that warns when a newer Avm.Authoring
version is available. Writes a warning once.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `Switch` |
| Required | false |
| Position | named |
| Default value | False |
| Accept pipeline input | false |
| Accept wildcard characters | false |

## Examples

### EXAMPLE 1

```powershell
Get-AvmVersion
```

## Outputs

- `System.Management.Automation.PSObject`
